newsitem.title: USA: Buckle June same-store sales up 17.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buckle June same-store sales up 17.7 pct.

text.p: Buckle Inc said same-store sales for the five weeks ended July 5 were up 17.7 percent from sales for the same period in the prior year.
The retailer said total sales for the period this year increased 30.2 percent to $18.2 million from $14.0 million in the corresponding five-week period of fiscal 1996.
Same-store sales year-to-date were up 12.6 percent from sales in the same 22-week period of the previous year.
Net sales year-to-date, for the 22 weeks ended July 5, increased 23.6 percent to $81.8 million from $66.1 million for the same 22 weeks in the prior year, the company said.
Buckle Inc sells casual apparel for young men and women through 189 stores in 25 states.
